description: Horaires des gares is a dataset listed in Roumoiseine open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gares & Connexions. Ce jeu de données contient les horaires d'ouverture au public des gares de voyageurs en France. Chaque gare est identifiée dans la colonne "UIC" par son code UIC (identifiant unique). Les horaires sont mentionnés pour chaque jour de la semaine dans la colonne "Horaire en jour normal". Coverage: Roumois Seine (Eure). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Gares, Horaires, Horaire, mobilité. The portal shows 6,517 records. The portal shows 2025-04-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-roumoiseine-fr-portal.
